Range of each attraction signal. Actual response depends on nearby simulated zombies, hearing and normal AI. The central outpost square must be loaded.

In-game time between attraction attempts, in 10-minute units: 1 = 10 minutes; 3 = 30 minutes; 6 = 1 hour; 12 = 2 hours. Default: 6. Population is rechecked when due. Unloaded attempts are skipped without a backlog.
Unclaimed, infested outposts at threat 4 periodically attract existing nearby zombies. Attraction stops below threat 4 or when claimed. This mechanic adds no zombies.

Count loaded living zombies within this distance of the center, across all floors. Bandit NPCs are excluded. Attraction stops at 50 plus one zombie for every two world days survived. The added amount is capped at 150: maximum 200 from day 300 onward. Arrivals may exceed the threshold.
Scales infected threats and loot timing in singleplayer/local games.
